privacy.lessons_are_recorded_and_faces_a: Lessons are recorded and faces are blurred
privacy.reel_processes_lecture_recording:
Reel processes lecture recordings for your organization.
Lessons are recorded. The system processes video, audio, speech transcripts, lesson details, and account information.
Confidently identified student faces are blurred. Faces may remain visible in uncertain cases. Face blurring is not infallible.
Unblurred source recordings are not served on the web. Videos may be published as unlisted YouTube links and shared in the group's Slack channel. Anyone who receives a link can share it with others.
Authorized group members and administrators can access the group's library. Operators can access job identifiers and diagnostics.
Account information, source recordings, and processing results are stored in the organization's system according to its cleanup settings. This page does not promise a fixed retention period.
You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data through your profile or an administrator. Administrators review requests in light of external publications and other people's rights. The system does not promise automatic deletion or completion within a fixed number of days.
A parent or legal guardian provides registration consent for AI Junior students. Registration records the guardian's declaration; it does not independently verify their identity or legal status.
Contact your organization's administrator with questions or to withdraw consent.
